group.name: BarNumber
group.midi.doc: Bar Number (7F 03 01): the bar that is playing.

field.name: Bar
field.midi.doc: The bar number (14 bits, signed); 00 40 (-8192): not running.

field.name: Length
field.midi.doc: The number of data bytes that follow.

field.name: Numerator
field.midi.doc: The number of beats in a bar.

field.name: DenominatorPower
field.midi.doc: The beat unit as a power of 2 (2: a quarter note).

field.name: ClocksPerClick
field.midi.doc: The number of MIDI clocks per metronome click.

field.name: ThirtySecondNotesPerQuarter
field.midi.doc: The number of notated 32nd notes in a MIDI quarter note (24 clocks).

repeat.name: Compound
repeat.midi.doc: More numerator/denominator pairs of a compound time signature.
